description: Verified guidance catalog and SKILL.md skills, Preparedness Action Planner Agent (ledger-assembled plan, deterministic topic fill, English-only with notice, checklist markdown) and Safety and Verification Agent (deterministic pass/fail checks incl. banned content and free-text claim check; optional non-blocking LLM review). Implements plan.md items 4-6 and decisions D5-D8. Depends on FEAT-001 (sources.py, claims.py, risk models, make_weather).
steps: Read d:\github work\SDK workshop\.agents\tasks\heatwise-m2\plan.md decisions D5-D9, items 4-6 and the Digest; read FEAT-001 findings.

Fetch (web_fetch, HTML only) and verify sources for outdoor-worker guidance, farmer/livestock guidance and an emergency number; candidates https://www.osha.gov/heat-exposure, CDC/NIOSH heat stress pages, https://112.gov.in (timed out once during planning). Add only pages actually read to TRUSTED_SOURCES. If no emergency number is verified, use generic 'contact local emergency services or the nearest health facility' wording with no number, and record that in findings.

Create backend/guidance/catalog.py: GuidanceItem model and CATALOG of paraphrased items (no quote over 30 words) covering household, outdoor_worker, farmer x before, during, after; each audience covers hydration, rest, shade and escalation; source_ids reference TRUSTED_SOURCES; catalog_for(audience, phase, category).

Create backend/skills/household-heat-preparedness/SKILL.md, backend/skills/outdoor-worker-heat-safety/SKILL.md, backend/skills/farmer-heat-preparedness/SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter name (equal to the directory name) and description, following _reference/strands-workshop/samples/03-skills-steering/skills/order-tracking/SKILL.md; instruct use of list_guidance/select_guidance and that only catalog ids are allowed; general advice only via add_general_advice.

Create backend/tests/test_guidance_catalog.py: all source_ids exist, all urls https, every audience x phase non-empty, required topics present per audience, skill dirs load (frontmatter name matches dir).

Create backend/models/plan.py (PlanItem, ChecklistItem, PreparednessPlan with checklist_markdown(), PlanIntro{intro: str}) and backend/tools/planning_tools.py (PLANNING_TOOL_NAMES, build_planning_tools(get_context): list_guidance(audience, phase), select_guidance(audience, phase, guidance_ids: str comma-separated; unknown ids -> tool_error invalid_argument), add_general_advice(audience, phase, text) <= 300 chars and <= settings.plan_max_general_advice).

Create backend/agents/planner_agent.py: ActionPlannerAgent(settings, model=None) with plugins=[AgentSkills(skills=[str(SKILLS_DIR)])], GuardrailHook allowlist = planning tools + 'skills' + 'PlanIntro' (both uncounted), cap planner_max_tool_calls; run(risk, profile, weather, revision_notes=None, revision=0) -> PreparednessPlan assembled from ledger, deterministic fill (added_by='rules'), language per D6 (SUPPORTED_PLAN_LANGUAGES=('en',), else English + language_notice), deterministic intro fallback, status 'skipped' when risk category unknown; last_trace/last_blocked/as_tool().

Create backend/tests/test_planner_agent.py (ScriptedModel): full selection for 3 audiences x 3 phases, missing topics filled by rules, unknown id rejected, 'hi' -> English + notice, 'skills' offered to model, checklist markdown covers all items, model failure -> deterministic plan, revision_notes appear in the prompt (inspect agent messages or ScriptedModel n_messages).

Create backend/models/verification.py (CheckResult, VerificationResult, SafetyReview{concern: str | None}), backend/tools/verification_tools.py (VERIFICATION_TOOL_NAMES, BANNED_PATTERNS, run_checks(weather, risk, plan) per plan item 6, build_verification_tools(get_context) exposing run_safety_checks()), backend/agents/safety_agent.py (SafetyVerificationAgent: deterministic result in code; optional LLM review adds llm_concerns only; skip model when settings.safety_llm_review is False).

Create backend/tests/test_safety_agent.py: clean plan passes; 'take aspirin' general advice fails; 'you have heat stroke' fails; 'clear skies' or a wrong °C number in intro fails; unknown source id fails; stale weather fails; demo data is a warning; LLM concern on a passing plan stays passed; LLM no-concern on a failing plan stays failed.
acceptance_criteria: Every catalog item's source_ids resolve to a TRUSTED_SOURCES entry that was fetched during this work
Safety pass/fail never depends on model output
verification: cd 'd:\github work\SDK workshop\heatwise-ai'; .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest backend/tests/test_guidance_catalog.py backend/tests/test_planner_agent.py backend/tests/test_safety_agent.py -q
findings:
VERIFICATION (2026-11-02): focused files -> 37 passed (test_guidance_catalog 17, test_planner_agent 11, test_safety_agent 9); full offline suite -> 159 passed, 3 deselected (70 original + 52 FEAT-001 + 37 FEAT-002). No new dependencies.

SOURCES (web_fetch 2026-11-02, added to TRUSTED_SOURCES in backend/guidance/sources.py): ready_gov_extreme_heat (https://www.ready.gov/heat; household actions, heat illness signs, escalation wording; its US 9-1-1 number is NOT used), nws_heat_safety (https://www.weather.gov/safety/heat; vulnerable groups, never leave children/pets in cars), who_workplace_heat_stress (https://www.who.int/news-room/questions-and-answers/item/workplace-heat-stress; heat exhaustion/stroke need emergency response, vulnerable workers), fao_extreme_heat_agrifood (https://www.fao.org/climate-change/news/news-detail/extreme-heat-in-an-el-ni%C3%B1o-year--how-agrifood-systems-can-prepare/en; farmer/crop/livestock measures, shade+water+rest breaks for farm workers), wsu_livestock_heat_wave (https://news.wsu.edu/news/2022/07/28/protect-livestock-pets-during-summer-heat-wave/; livestock water, handling times, shade/ventilation, after-heat watch, vet contact). NOT readable, not cited: osha.gov/heat-exposure, /protecting-workers, /water-rest-shade and cdc.gov/niosh heat-stress (HTTP 403); 112.gov.in and 112.gov.in/faq (timeout); police.sikkim.gov.in/visitor/erss (TLS error); ndma.gov.in heat-wave pages (404); dol.ny.gov guidance (PDF). EMERGENCY NUMBER: none verified, so escalation text uses catalog.ESCALATION_CONTACT = 'contact local emergency services or the nearest health facility' with no number (test asserts no 112/911 in catalog). Worth recording as a gap in tasks.md.

MODULES/NAMES: backend/guidance/catalog.py: Audience/Phase/Topic Literals, AUDIENCES, PHASES, REQUIRED_TOPICS=('hydration','rest','shade','escalation'), CATEGORY_ORDER, ESCALATION_CONTACT, GuidanceItem{id, audience, phase, topic, text, source_ids (min 1), min_category='low'}, CATALOG dict (43 items, ids like 'hh-during-hydration-1', 'ow-...', 'fm-...'; two items min_category='moderate': ow-during-work_schedule-1, fm-during-livestock_crops-1), catalog_for(audience, phase=None, category=None) (None/'unknown' category -> all items).
backend/skills/{household-heat-preparedness,outdoor-worker-heat-safety,farmer-heat-preparedness}/SKILL.md (load with Skill.from_file(strict=True)).
backend/models/plan.py: PlanItem{id, audience, phase, topic ('general' for general advice), text, source_ids, kind sourced|general_educational, added_by agent|rules}, ChecklistItem, PreparednessPlan{status ok|skipped, language, requested_language, language_notice, risk_category, intro, intro_source model|rules, items, checklist, revision, issues} + checklist_markdown() (headings '## Households/Outdoor workers/Farmers', '### Before/During/After the heat', '- [ ] text'; notice in italics), PlanIntro{intro}.
backend/tools/planning_tools.py: PLANNING_TOOL_NAMES, GENERAL_ADVICE_MAX_CHARS=300, PlanningContext(risk_category, audiences, max_general_advice, general_advice_count), build_planning_tools(get_context): list_guidance(audience, phase='all'), select_guidance(audience, phase, guidance_ids) (any unknown/foreign/above-category id -> whole call rejected with tool_error invalid_argument), add_general_advice(audience, phase, text). Tools return JSON strings; audiences outside the plan are rejected.
backend/agents/planner_agent.py: AGENT_NAME='action_planner', SKILLS_DIR, SUPPORTED_PLAN_LANGUAGES=('en',), AUDIENCE_SKILLS, plan_audiences(profile) (household always + outdoor_worker if profile.outdoor_workers + farmer if profile.farmers), resolve_language, deterministic_intro(risk, audiences), build_prompt, assemble_items(records, audiences, category, max_general_advice), check_intro, ActionPlannerAgent(settings, model=None, skills_dir=SKILLS_DIR).run(risk, profile=None, weather=None, revision_notes=None, revision=0) -> PreparednessPlan; last_trace, last_blocked, last_prompt; as_tool() -> 'action_planner'(risk_json, profile_json='{}', weather_json='', revision_notes='' newline-separated). Limits: turns = planner_max_tool_calls + 2, structured_output_attempts=2. Guardrail uncounted: 'skills','PlanIntro'; ledger ignores PlanIntro but records 'skills' calls.
backend/models/verification.py: CheckResult, VerificationResult{status, checks, issues, warnings, llm_concerns, verified_item_ids, pct_items_verified}, SafetyReview{concern}.
backend/tools/verification_tools.py: VERIFICATION_TOOL_NAMES=('run_safety_checks',), BANNED_PATTERNS (code, regex, message): medication, dosing, diagnosis, discourage_help, alcohol, limit_water, external_action; banned_hits(text); run_checks(weather, risk, plan) check names: weather_data, weather_freshness, weather_live (warning), weather_sources, risk_present, plan_present, risk_category_match, item_sources, escalation_present, banned_content (all texts incl. weather summary, risk explanation, intro, every item), text_claims (weather summary, risk explanation, intro, general advice only; numbers via risk_agent.evidence_numbers); VerificationContext; build_verification_tools.
backend/agents/safety_agent.py: AGENT_NAME='safety_verifier', SafetyVerificationAgent(settings, model=None).run(weather, risk, plan) -> VerificationResult; last_trace, last_blocked. No as_tool (not in FEAT-002 steps).

DEVIATIONS: (1) Model-failure/no-selection fallback = the full catalog for every plan audience (added_by='rules'), not just a minimal fill; with some selections, the fill adds one item per empty audience x phase and one per missing required topic. (2) list_guidance takes phase='all' (default) so 3 audiences fit within planner_max_tool_calls=14 (3 list + 9 select). (3) PreparednessPlan has extra fields intro_source and issues; VerificationResult has extra 'warnings'. (4) An LLM concern adds a failed warning-severity CheckResult 'llm_review' plus llm_concerns; status unchanged. (5) Plan audiences come from the profile (household always). (6) Spec files (tasks.md/design.md/requirements.md) not edited in this step (item 10).
